row_semantics: Each row represents a specific interface or mode definition related to vehicle mode management.

column_semantics.Interface Name: The name of the interface, which should match the logic block content.
column_semantics.Direction: Indicates whether the interface is for input/output, provide/consume.
column_semantics.Type: Specifies the type of interface, such as CAN/LIN/SOA service or hardline.
column_semantics.Sender/Provider: Identifies the signal sender or SoA service provider.
column_semantics.Receiver/Consumer: Identifies the signal receiver or SoA service consumer.

core_entities.name: VehMd
core_entities.description: Vehicle Mode, representing different operational states of the vehicle.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the various vehicle modes (VehMd) and their corresponding hexadecimal values, which are used to configure and identify different operational states of the vehicle. It is crucial for testing the correct implementation and switching between these modes in the vehicle's electronic systems.
